[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 60
- Description: SunMint introduction for Kenny & Matthew — direction, corrections & iteration (Gary Teh)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/534
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/532
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1657
  
  Details:
  Direct time — direction, corrections and iteration on the SunMint introduction document prepared for Kenny & Matthew.
  
  WHAT CHANGED
  - Drove the SunMint partner-introduction deliverable (6→8 page PDF) from a data-style pack into a partner-ready narrative document: real SunMint logo, live impact-map satellite capture, clickable field-video thumbnails, and five field photos (cover school group, CEPOTX nursery, CFR Anapu students, forest-giant feature, planting sapling).
  - Corrected the registry-label semantics: the 21 "proposed" plots are NOT proposals — trees are already planted and being tabulated by the cooperative. Reworded the pack and doc to "planted ≠ counted ≠ verified".
  - Diagnosed and directed the layout-crop fixes: the logo was clipped by a CSS margin-collapse bleed-to-edge bug; then per-image the "crop from top" blanket rule was replaced (CFR Anapu selfie-angle photo pre-cropped to an exact ratio) so faces are never cut.
  - Set the content guardrails: no DAO/token references, no reference to the source brief, and the "figures not to use" section de-identified and reframed as a neutral FAQ.
  
  WHY
  - Partner-facing honesty: state plainly that no tradeable carbon credit exists yet, and that 245 trees are individually counted while more are planted and awaiting the census — credibility over over-claiming.
  
  EVIDENCE
  - Verifiable live figures used in the document (245 trees · 273.43 ha · 15 farms · 22 plots · 8 species · 1,084 media): https://truesight.me/stats/sunmint_index.json
  - Related merged work in this session:
    - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/534
    - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/532
    - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1657
  
  NOTE: minutes are an estimate (Gary did not specify); TDG auto-computed from Type + Amount per rubric. May be adjusted on request.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- TDG Issued: 100.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
